conclusion: Partially supported: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the need for orthogonal characterization, defined release criteria, validated intact-EV assays, and rigorous production reporting; however, the reviewer assertions that program-specific artifacts for SGL-001 (MCB/WCB, validated assays, batch/stability/potency data, and bridging biodistribution studies) are absent cannot be verified from the supplied evidence set because the only provided evidence is the MISEV guidance and contains no program-specific records.
unsupported_assertions: The supplied evidence does not demonstrate that SGL-001 has produced or validated the specific MCB/WCB, release assays, or stability/potency reproducibility required to advance formulations.
Current materials do not demonstrate characterized source-cell MCB/WCB or scalable, reproducible production sufficient to support advancing a specific intranasal formulation.

The supplied evidence does not include program-specific orthogonal intact-EV analytics or controlled bridging biodistribution studies for SGL-001, therefore rodent intranasal biodistribution data are insufficient for cross-species translation in this program.
